Compliance_Justification: Tokenization ensures LLM can differentiate entities without exposing actual email addresses to third-party network.
Format-preserving masking allows AI to perform risk checks on the last 4 digits while keeping full PAN strictly in RAM.
Strict PII is never allowed to leave the EUC. UI intercepts and blocks transmission to protect user identity.
Approved bank-wide identifiers are safe for AI context analysis and establish system accountability.
